name: @atharvadevne123/reflective-lantern
description: Autonomous code improvement agent — system prompts and configuration

scripts.test: node -e "const r = require('.'); const v = r.validate(); console.log(v.valid ? 'OK' : v.errors.join('\n')); process.exit(v.valid ? 0 : 1);"
scripts.test:prompts: node -e "const r = require('.'); const p = r.getPrompts(); console.log('Prompts:', Object.keys(p));"
scripts.test:history: node -e "const r = require('.'); const h = r.getHistory(); console.log('History repos:', Object.keys(h).length);"
scripts.validate: node -e "const {validate} = require('.'); const v = validate(); console.log(JSON.stringify(v, null, 2));"
